commands.command: Extend or reuse the learned-history probe so it can train the exact M143 P0-P4 sequence profiles under one frozen recipe.
commands.name: m144_profile_sequence_probe

commands.command: Run at least three seeds with identical train/test split policy, history window, targets, hidden size, epochs, optimizer, and regularization across profiles.
commands.name: m144_multiseed_repeat

decision_rule: Admit a profile for PPO comparison only if the M143 supervised deltas survive regularized learned-history probes across multiple seeds without profile-specific tuning.
failure_criteria: learned-history profile comparison uses different model sizes, epochs, seeds, targets, or regularization per profile
P3/P4 gains disappear or are dominated by variance across seeds
the probe adds slip ratio, slip angle, controller flags, hidden simulator parameters, or oracle labels
hypothesis: The M143 P3/P4 ridge gains may reflect real deployable history signal, but they must survive a regularized sequence probe before any PPO profile comparison.
success_criteria: exact M143 P0-P4 feature profiles are used
at least three seeds are run
same learned-history recipe is used for every profile
artifacts record per-target, per-profile, and multiseed aggregate deltas
no non-deployable actor inputs are introduced
